category_title: Grade 1 students who resist collaboration and require one-to-one guidance
minimal_context: Kylie and her partner are looking for relationships between areas and recording statements using uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your partner to look for relationships between the areas and record your statements using uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits next to her partner but works independently without discussion) I wrote my equation. It says t+e+L=r.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Examine your work. Remember we need to use uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Erases the first letter) I rewrote my equation as T+e+L=r.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Work together with your partner to finish correcting the rest of the letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Passively watches as her partner points to the paper without explaining) He just told me to write T+E+L=R, so I'm just going to copy that.
